Excalifont (extended) Chalkboard MathLive adapter FONTLOG

Adapter version: 0.1.0
Excalifont (extended) version: 0.1.0
MathLive compatibility: 0.110.0
Release provenance: 0.1.0

Compatibility decisions
- MathLive is pinned to exactly 0.110.0. No other MathLive release is certified.
- The KaTeX_* names are CSS/runtime compatibility identifiers. To preserve the
  template fonts' declared Reserved Font Names, delivered binaries use internal
  primary family names beginning with Excalifont Extended ML.
- All delivered glyph outlines are generated from Excalifont sources.
- Ordinary glyphs retain Excalifont's native outlines, advances, and vertical
  metrics exactly. Only MathLive's split radical pieces and extensible delimiter
  attachment zones are fitted to compatibility assembly boxes.
- Adapter 0.1.0 uses the 0.1.0 CSS cache token on every face URL.
- KaTeX_Main includes Excalifont's complete BMP text-release cmap in all four
  declared faces for mixed prose, Extended Latin, Vietnamese, Greek, marks,
  punctuation, symbols, spacing, and joining controls.
- Outline-equivalent OTF/TTF files accompany every WOFF2 face for vector export.

Release history
- 0.1.0: Initial public adapter release. It includes native ordinary
  outlines and metrics, compatibility-fitted radicals and Size4 delimiters,
  the refined capital H, i, letter-dot, comma, semicolon, and low-quote families,
  all 20 browser/export faces, mixed-text support, Chromium/Firefox certification,
  deterministic packaging, and portable checksums.

See README.md for provenance and license details.
